# King Tatakosi — Frontend Developer Portfolio

> Frontend developer building fast, effective websites and practical web tools that help small businesses grow online.

King Tatakosi builds responsive, professional websites that convert visitors into customers, along with practical browser-based tools (inventory trackers, debtor management apps) for small and medium-sized businesses.

## Services
- Business Websites: clean, fast, mobile-friendly websites, from landing pages to multi-section sites.
- Online Visibility: SEO-ready pages, Google Business Profile setup, performance-optimised code.
- Simple Web Tools: custom browser-based tools — inventory management, debtor tracking, invoice generators.

## Projects
- [VendaPal](https://king-tatakosi.github.io/vendapal-app/): offline-first business tool for tracking inventory, customer/supplier debts, and product expiry.
- [Royal Hawk Hotel](https://royalhawk-hotel.vercel.app/): a demonstrative hotel landing page designed for clear conversion and a polished mobile experience.

## Skills
HTML5, CSS3 & responsive design, JavaScript (ES6+), React.js, Git & GitHub. Currently deepening skills in Node.js and databases next.
